map.根据流量、压差和介质密度计算 Cv/Kv 值，推荐阀门通径: From flow, pressure drop and medium density, compute the Cv / Kv value and recommend a valve nominal diameter.
map.📖 查看「阀门选型计算（Cv/Kv 流量系数）使用指南」: View the valve sizing (Cv/Kv flow coefficient) usage guide
map.Cv = Q × √(ρ/ΔP) × 换算系数；口径按 Cv 选标准通径: Cv = Q times sqrt(rho / delta P) times conversion factor; nominal diameter selected by Cv against standard series
map.基于阀门流量系数(Cv/Kv)模型：由流量 Q、介质密度 ρ 与压差 ΔP 计算: Based on a valve flow-coefficient (Cv/Kv) model: from flow Q, medium density rho and pressure drop delta P compute the required flow coefficient, and combined with the standard nominal-diameter series recommend the valve size, for control-valve / globe-valve selection check.
map.💡 Cv = 1.167 × Q × √(SG / ΔP)；Kv = Q × √: Tip: Cv = 1.167 times Q times sqrt(SG / delta P); Kv = Q times sqrt(SG / delta P); SG = medium density / water density; recommended nominal diameter taken at 1.3 times the design Cv margin
map.本公式适用于液体介质（不可压缩流体）: This formula applies to liquid media (incompressible fluid)
map.气体介质需考虑压缩性修正，请使用专用气体阀门计算: Gas media need compressibility correction; please use a dedicated gas valve calculator
map.实际选型还需考虑介质温度、腐蚀性和阀门材质: Actual selection should also consider medium temperature, corrosiveness and valve material
map.调节阀选型：由流量、压差与介质密度算 Cv/Kv 并选通径: Control-valve selection: compute Cv/Kv from flow, pressure drop and medium density and select the nominal diameter
map.口径校核：用估算流速判断所选通径是否合适: Diameter check: judge whether the selected diameter is suitable by estimated flow velocity
map.既有阀门评估：反算 Cv 判断开度与调节性能: Existing valve assessment: back-compute Cv to judge opening and regulation performance
map.算法：相对密度 SG = 介质密度/1000；Kv = 流量×√(SG/压差)；: Algorithm: specific gravity SG = medium density / 1000; Kv = flow times sqrt(SG / pressure drop); Cv = 1.167 times Kv; design Cv = Cv times 1.3; among the standard nominal-diameter Cv series take the first entry at least the design Cv as the recommended diameter; estimated velocity = flow / (pipe cross-section times 3600) (m/s), below 1 m/s is low, above 4 m/s is high. Standard series Cv: DN15 4, DN20 7.5, DN25 12, DN32 17, DN40 25, DN50 40, DN65 68, DN80 98, DN100 160, DN125 250, DN150 360, DN200 650, DN250 1000, DN300 1600.
map.例：流量 20m³/h、压差 1bar、水（1000kg/m³）→ SG=1、K: Example: flow 20 m3/h, pressure drop 1 bar, water (1000 kg/m3) gives SG = 1, Kv = 20.00, Cv = 23.34, design Cv = 30.34, recommended DN50 (Cv 40), estimated velocity 2.83 m/s, judged as reasonable velocity. If flow 50 m3/h, pressure drop 2 bar, medium 800 kg/m3 gives SG = 0.8, Kv = 31.62, Cv = 36.90, design Cv = 47.97, recommended DN65 (Cv 68), velocity 4.19 m/s, hint as high velocity, suggest enlarging the diameter.
map.Kv 和 Cv 有什么区别？: What is the difference between Kv and Cv?
map.Kv 是国际单位制流量系数（m³/h，压差 1bar、介质为水）；Cv 是英制（: Kv is the SI flow coefficient (m3/h, 1 bar pressure drop, water as medium); Cv is the imperial (US gal/min, 1 psi pressure drop). Conversion is Cv = 1.167 times Kv; when selecting, be sure which one the manufacturer data uses.
map.为阀门开度与工况波动留余量，避免阀门长期在过大开度工作导致调节性能变差。调节型阀: To leave margin for valve opening and operating fluctuations, avoiding long-term operation at too-large opening that degrades regulation. Control valves usually take 1.3 to 2.0 times the computed Cv, combined with authority and rangeability checks.
map.阀门选型计算器根据液体流量、压差和介质密度，计算阀门的 Cv 值和 Kv 值，并: The valve sizing calculator computes the valve Cv and Kv values from liquid flow, pressure drop and medium density, and recommends a suitable valve nominal diameter (DN) at 1.3 times the design margin, while estimating whether the pipe velocity is reasonable.
